> irt_gpcm<-mirt(df_com,model=mirt_model,itemtype ='gpcm',method = 'MHRM',dentype = "Gaussian",verbose=FALSE,technical = list(theta_lim=c(-6, 6)))

parts:

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: real data--MH sampler failed. Model is likely unstable or may need better starting valuesFALSE
parts:
Sure, but mean difference information is absorbed into the intercepts anyway. So there's no need to constrain the intercepts unless you believe the difficulties should be equal across items (at which point the MEAN parameters would represent overall changes in difficulties, removing all the item-level idiosyncrasies). As you described it, I don't see any reason to do so, so omitting the MEAN argument and estimating the intercepts likely makes the most sense.

Phil
